say:1:1130607001:1.text: Since the truth about the treasure broke, fewer people have visited Alkali.
say:1:1130607001:1.source_cn: 自从宝藏传闻被打破后，往来咸水镇的人变少了。
say:1:1130607001:1.male: Since the truth about the treasure broke, fewer people have visited Alkali.
say:1:1130607001:1.female: Since the truth about the treasure broke, fewer people have visited Alkali.

say:2:1130607002:1.text: But I've also heard there are fewer bandits, too. Instead of focusing on weapons, people are taking up interest in everyday necessities and even art.
say:2:1130607002:1.source_cn: 不过听说强盗也少了，大家不再关注武器，反而对日用品和艺...
say:2:1130607002:1.male: But I've also heard there are fewer bandits, too. Instead of focusing on weapons, people are taking up interest in everyday necessities and even art.
say:2:1130607002:1.female: But I've also heard there are fewer bandits, too. Instead of focusing on weapons, people are taking up interest in everyday necessities and even art.

say:3:1130607003:1.text: All of my favorite paintings sold, but they were all bought by people who appreciate art, so I don't feel regret.
say:3:1130607003:1.source_cn: 我最喜欢的画都被买走了……不过他们都是懂艺术的人，我也...
say:3:1130607003:1.male: All of my favorite paintings sold, but they were all bought by people who appreciate art, so I don't feel regret.
say:3:1130607003:1.female: All of my favorite paintings sold, but they were all bought by people who appreciate art, so I don't feel regret.

say:4:1130607004:1.text: You're a very easy person to chat with. I hope you come by more often.
say:4:1130607004:1.source_cn: 谢谢您，和您聊天很轻松，希望您能常来。
say:4:1130607004:1.male: You're a very easy person to chat with. I hope you come by more often.
say:4:1130607004:1.female: You're a very easy person to chat with. I hope you come by more often.
